label: Duplicate GST in invoice summary and remittance stub — must not double-count

expected.notes: Slice 2 tax-dedup regression — GST appears TWICE in the document (invoice summary + remittance stub). The tax extractor must return 225.00, NOT 450.00. Reconciliation with printed total 4725.00 disambiguates.
